name: Corrahn's Dagger
summary: Corrahn's Dagger is the second ridge among the four mountainous fingers towering over northern Hillsbrad Foothills. This high ground serves as a hideout for rogue Syndicate operatives.

sections.title: A Northern Strongpoint
sections.body: Rising steeply in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, Corrahn's Dagger is the second of the four rocky projections known locally as the fingers of Hillsbrad. The ridge is overrun by cutthroats belonging to the Syndicate, who use the elevated perch to overlook the valley below.

faq.answer: The ridge is held by rogue humans of the Syndicate, who keep the heights as a hideout.

faq.q: Why are the dwarves stationed here?
faq.answer: No dwarven force is stationed on Corrahn's Dagger. The ridge belongs to Syndicate cutthroats, who use it as a hideout overlooking the foothills.

faq.q: Who used to hold this ridge before the dwarves?
faq.answer: No dwarves have taken the ridge. Corrahn's Dagger is occupied by rogue humans affiliated with the Syndicate.

faq.q: What are the fingers of Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: The fingers of Hillsbrad are four prominent, finger-like mountain ridges projecting southward from the northern mountain range into the Hillsbrad valley. Corrahn's Dagger is the second of these formations.

angles.text: The ridge is a Syndicate hideout, so dwarven travelers crossing the northern foothills should expect bandits rather than allies.
The Syndicate cutthroats on the ridge are hostile to the Forsaken working in Hillsbrad.
